description: Negative control found by evaluator mutation testing (mutant M11, scripts/lib/mutants.ts) — NOT anticipated when M11 was written, found only by actually running the mutation-test script. INF-021's distractor-confusion answer OMITS the needle value entirely (it reports 8000 instead of 4000), so a mutant that ignores distractor leakage still correctly fails INF-021 via the missing-needle path alone, never actually exercising the distractor-specific bug. This case reports BOTH the correct needle value AND a leaked distractor value in the same answer, isolating the distractor check: the needle-presence check alone would say PASS here, so only a check that ALSO looks at distractors can correctly fail it.
